name: createSingleOption
input: PatternBuilder with exactly one option added (via withPattern or internal state)
expected: Returns that single Option instance directly without wrapping in a Group, and clears options via reset().

name: createMultipleOptions
expected: Returns a Group Option containing all added options (built using gbuilder), and clears options via reset().

name: createResetsStateAfterCreation
input: PatternBuilder with options added, calling create()
expected: After creation, internal options set is empty, verified by subsequent create() returning empty group or throwing/behaving accordingly.

name: resetClearsOptions
expected: options set size becomes 0, and returns the PatternBuilder instance itself for method chaining.

name: resetOnEmptyBuilder
expected: Does nothing harmful, keeps options empty, and returns the PatternBuilder instance.

name: createOptionWithoutArgument
expected: Creates an option with short name 'a', not required, no argument, and adds it to options.

name: createOptionWithRequiredArgument
expected: Creates an option with short name 'b', required = true, with a NumberValidator argument having minimum 1 and maximum 1, and adds it to options.

name: createOptionWithStarTypeArgument
expected: Creates an option with short name 'c', with a FileValidator argument having minimum 0 (default) and no maximum limit (since type == '*'), and adds it to options.

name: createOptionWithClassValidatorTypeAt
expected: Creates an option with short name 'd', with a ClassValidator instance set to instance=true, max 1, and adds it to options.

name: createOptionWithClassValidatorTypePlus
expected: Creates an option with short name 'e', with a ClassValidator instance set to instance=false (default), max 1, and adds it to options.

name: createOptionWithDateValidator
expected: Creates an option with short name 'f', with a DateValidator instance, max 1, and adds it to options.

name: createOptionWithFileValidatorExisting
expected: Creates an option with short name 'g', with a FileValidator configured for existing=true and file=true, max 1, and adds it to options.

name: createOptionWithFileValidatorGreaterThan
expected: Creates an option with short name 'h', with a default FileValidator instance, max 1, and adds it to options.

name: createOptionWithUrlValidator
expected: Creates an option with short name 'i', with a UrlValidator instance, max 1, and adds it to options.

name: createOptionWithUnknownTypeCharacter
expected: Creates an option with short name 'j', with null validator for argument (or default argument behavior), max 1, and adds it to options.
